body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Hitachi presents its new LCD projectors including the CP-X10000 and CP-WX11000 during CES 2009. The Hitachi CP-X10000 features 1024×768 resolution and 7500 ANSI lumens while the Hitachi CP-WX11000 offers 1280×800 and 6500 lumens.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
